caption: The drawing features three decorated rectangular boxes placed close together, each predominantly in shades of pink and purple. The boxes are embellished with green and purple circular gemstones and gold beaded patterns, giving them an ornate appearance. Flowing, ruffled fabric surrounds and partially covers the boxes, with the fabric rendered in various tones of pink and lavender. The background is plain and unadorned, leaving the objects centered and isolated in the upper middle portion of the composition. The decorative details, such as the gemstones and gold accents on the boxes, add visual texture and intricacy to the arrangement.
